summary: Capstone Holding Corp. filed an 8-K to report an amended equity line financing agreement, replacing prior VWAP purchase mechanics with pre-market and intraday VWAP purchase options. The issuer retains the right to sell up to $20 million of common stock at 97% of VWAP, with per-purchase caps of 1 million shares or 25% of volume. No terms are provided for price per share, premium, or close date. This is a routine financing facility amendment rather than a special-situation event. It does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or any other enumerated category. The filing is classified as none.
